verdict.rationale: Warp's own site says it offers an SDK alongside its API, CLI and MCP, and a probe found a published OpenAPI spec. That is the product's own claimed capability, but it rests on a single marketing line with no SDK documentation behind it. missing for 10: SDK documentation or reference pages, supported languages and package names, install and usage examples, versioning or maintenance details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: API, CLI, SDK and MCP built as a platform, not a vertical product or AI teammate.
